CONTROLS.NAME: paint_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add a circular 'paint brush' to the scene. Other controls invert the brush, change the brush size, or change the position.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint_invert
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: paint on must be on. Inverts the paintbrush from 'cutting out' the simulation or painting where it is on.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint_size
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: paint on must be on. Brush size.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint_pos
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: paint on must be on. Move to move the paintbrush.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_slice
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Slicing action will automatically happen on the beats in the music with this set to on. Otherwise, turn this off and manually slice with the slice_pos.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_slice
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: auto slice must be OFF to see this action. Move to manually slice the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: drips
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes the simulation to make it more drippy when on.
